_comment: Plane-4 standing tool-surface baseline (scripts/check-tool-surface.mjs). Growth is ALLOWED but never silent: raise a value and record `reason` + `recordedAt` saying what capability it buys. Dispatch-time caps are governed elsewhere and are not the subject of this baseline.

registry.toolDefinitions.reason: The 12 banking books-loop tools (S-FIN, BI-DE27D34E): the loop existed only as UI server actions, so no coworker could keep the books current. A bookkeeper needs to set up accounts, import a statement, categorize via rules, and reconcile through governed tools; no existing tool carries account setup, CSV statement import, or transaction matching. Six reads/banking_read, six writes/banking_write; the two money-of-record writes route the governance gate.

registry.packFiles.reason: New statutory-rate-pack.ts (BI-8E1FD1BD): the two tools a research coworker needs to deliver a cited statutory figure — list_statutory_rate_gaps and propose_statutory_rate. They belong in no existing pack, and the alternative was what already existed: coworkers holding web_search that could research a tax rate and had no way to record it, so the finding died in a backlog item. Deliberately no ratify tool — confirming a figure is a human action on the finance surface.

tier.coreToolNames.reason: Promotes find_coworker into the lean core tier so peer CLIs without client-side ToolSearch (Grok, Codex) can discover the coworker roster to route A2A handoffs — same rationale that keeps principle_decide/wiki_query core. Discovery-only; execution still gates on grants. BI-5FB59BC6.
